title: SENTRA dataset cleaning report
cleaning_policy: Preserved original field values, labels, list ordering, and data types.
Did not generate, infer, rewrite, or correct any labels or prompts.
Kept the official train, test1, and test2 files separate.
Removed no records from the official train/test splits because no duplicate model-input examples were found within those splits.
For the older LLM-generated file, removed exact duplicate rows based on all 14 retained columns.
Rows with empty or invalid intent_labels were excluded from the labeled supplemental file and placed in a separate quarantine file.
The LLM supplemental file is not merged into the official training split.

sentra_llm_supplement_exact_deduplicated.role: supplemental data; do not merge into official train without review
sentra_llm_supplement_exact_deduplicated.note: Some rows share identical prompt, context, and labels but differ in user_role. They were retained to preserve distinct metadata.

sentra_llm_unlabeled_quarantine.jsonl.role: excluded from supervised training pending human labeling

important_limitations: This cleaning process checks structural validity, missing labels, exact duplicates, and split overlap; it does not prove that the original human/LLM annotations are semantically correct.
The 59 unlabeled records have not been assigned labels.
The supplemental LLM data has repeated model inputs across user_role values and should not be blindly appended to the official training split.
